pillars.title: A trustworthy ally for a healthier Bangladesh.
pillars.lede: Operations across Bangladesh — broad, comprehensive, and constantly evolving. Four pillars guide every project we take on.

items.title: A trusted long-term ally to every hospital we work with.
items.body: Procurement, planning, training, and post-installation service — handled end-to-end, so clinical teams stay focused on patients. The relationship continues long after the equipment is in the ward.
items.imageAlt: Medical team standing together in a hospital corridor

items.title: Clinical-grade tools, calibrated for real workloads.
items.body: From OR tables to OEM-sourced imaging suites — each line is chosen for clinical accuracy, serviceability, and a 7–10 year operating life. Spec sheets are the easy part; what survives a third shift in a busy ward is the hard part.
items.imageAlt: Modern operating room with surgical robotics and imaging systems

items.title: Healthcare that doesn't depend on a postcode.
items.body: Equipment donations, screening camps, and clinician training in the districts the supply chain usually forgets. Impact is measured in training hours delivered and kilometres covered — not photo opportunities.
items.imageAlt: Nurse holding a patient's hand in reassurance

items.title: Local engineers, international standards.
items.body: Hands-on apprenticeships, OEM certification, and overseas postings for biomedical engineers and clinical specialists. The reason hospitals call us back is usually a person, not a product.
items.imageAlt: Lab technician operating a clinical analyzer machine

businessSegments.title: Five categories. One coherent system.
businessSegments.lede: Built so a hospital can source everything from procurement through training under one accountable partner.

items.title: Envisioning the future, with smart healthcare.
items.body: From bedside monitors to operating theatres, our solutions are evidence-driven and clinician-approved.

items.title: Hospital medical furniture & disposable devices.
items.body: Beds, trolleys, OT tables, gloves, masks, gowns, drapes — sourced to international standards.

items.title: Patient care & critical care.
items.body: Monitoring, infusion, ICU/NICU/CCU equipment. Reliable when minutes count.

items.title: OR & surgical solutions.
items.body: Operating tables, surgical lights, anesthesia, ESU, minimally invasive sets, orthopedic implants.

items.title: Medical imaging & laboratory diagnostics.
items.body: Ultrasound, X-ray, C-arm, CT, MRI, mammography — plus hematology, chemistry, immunoassay & reagents.

csr.intro: SPIBER aspires to enhance healthcare for all. Our work to be an outstanding corporate citizen grows alongside our philosophy — year after year, hospital after hospital, district after district.
csr.quote: We endeavor to be an outstanding corporate citizen — growing every year with the same philosophy that started us.

pillars.title: Devoted to communities
pillars.body: Useful products and solutions delivered to the regions of Bangladesh that need them most — from district hospitals to rural diagnostic outposts.

pillars.title: Promoting public health
pillars.body: Vigorous support for preventive-care programs, screening drives, and partnerships that widen the front door to modern medicine.

pillars.title: Dispersing technology
pillars.body: Continued investment in advanced equipment so the quality of care does not depend on the postcode of the patient.

pillars.title: Fostering medical talents
pillars.body: A knowledge-sharing platform — workshops, residencies, OEM training — that helps Bangladeshi clinicians grow and lead.

Two decades of clinical leadership — championed major hospital partnerships and ICU rollouts across Bangladesh.
Operations and supply-chain lead — runs SPIBER's biomedical service, parts logistics, and 24×7 field support.
Marketing and brand — leads SPIBER's clinical-education programs and partner outreach across the region.
